Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the name [Sistermon Noir] and the [Virus] trait.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly?(*This card's "Also treated as Name: [Sistermon Noir] and Trait: [Virus]" has been changed to "(Rule) Also treated as Name: [Sistermon Noir] and Trait: [Virus]")

Effect: [All Turns] All of your Digimon with [Huckmon] in their names or [Royal Knight] in their types get +2000 DP.
